thesis: The episode argues that Nintendo has successfully transformed from a cyclical hardware business into a perpetual platform with evergreen software, offering a dirt-cheap entry point for explosive growth. Conversely, it contends that Western Big Tech peers (Google and Microsoft) face permanently impaired business models due to their reliance on photorealistic graphics and multi-platform fragmentation. Vistry is presented as a superior UK home-building partner with exceptional returns on capital, though the episode also notes a specific China risk to the broader Big Tech sector.
